# Preview and test artwork

These files are fixture assets, not evidence of the owner's real collection. `scripts/qa-fixture.mjs` copies them into the isolated `.qa/vault/Attachments` directory; it does not change the real vault.

- `moores-creek-sample.png`: generated with Image Gen on 26 September 2026 for the one-cancellation Moores Creek design preview. It is marked as sample artwork and is not an authentic park cancellation or a verified design.
- `sample-stamp.png`: generic test image used for layout and legacy-data checks.
- `yellowstone/`: sample cancellation illustrations and the previously sourced Artist Point photograph. See [Yellowstone preview asset provenance](../../../docs/design/yellowstone-preview-assets.md).

The wide and tall layout test images are copied separately from the design handoff by the fixture builder. They are deliberately unsuitable as actual stamp photographs so browser verification can exercise image containment.
